html:
ALIENS HAVE INVADED THE EARTH!

Kidnapping the famous soccer idol Bro-naldo they demand the World Cup trophy for his release and of course our surrender!

Who can save us now? Well, Soccerboy of course, using his awesome ball skills he is destined to defeat the alien horde, rescue Bro-naldo and save mankind!

This is "Soccerboy vs Aliens!"

UNIQUE ENVIRONMENTS

Complete five unique zones, the first one available for free - the Americas - and Africa, Asia, Europe and Outer Space  as DLC. Complete each one to earn the continental trophies as well as the World Cup! Each zone contains new and exciting gameplay, dangerously devious hazards, sly enemies and gigantic bosses!

BALL SKILLS

The soccer ball is your best friend! What you have learnt on the training field will make you victorious. Use the environment to your advantage, a well timed ball bounce or bounce pad will help you defeat your enemies quicker or allow you to collect those hard to reach gold coins! But be careful, losing your ball will make you more vulnerable although you have your slide tackle if needs be!

HAZARDS AND CONTRAPTIONS

Beware of hazards that will either damage you or your ball.

Spikes will hurt you and pop your trusted football, quicksand will drag you down to your death! But not all objects in the world are dangerous, some are useful, bounce pads, fans and teleporters can aid you to complete levels or take down your enemies!

COLLECT ITEMS AND COINS

The levels are strewn with coins which can be used in store to purchase new outfits.

Items can also be found in the level, from hearts to powers. You will also find crates, which house random items, so go ahead and smash one to find out what's inside! 

DON YOUR TEAM JERSEY

Want Soccerboy to wear your favourite teams jersey? Then go into the store and start spending the coins you collected.

Get your club or country kits, or just collect them all!

DEFEAT BOSSES

Each zone ends with a tough and challenging boss to defeat. Learn their moves and use your skills to save planet Earth... and Bro-naldo of course!
